name: Drugs And Alcohol
overview: Scripture warns clearly against the deceptive and destructive nature of wine and strong drink, portraying them as sources of mockery, rage, and poor judgment. Those who indulge in excessive drinking face sorrow, contention, and impaired vision, as seen in the failures of even priests and prophets. Leaders, such as kings and princes, are specifically cautioned against consuming alcohol, emphasizing the importance of wisdom and self-control. Overall, the Bible presents a sober call to avoid the pitfalls of pleasure found in drugs and alcohol, urging believers to pursue righteousness instead.
